text:
🍨 Món ăn

Chè Xuân Trang là quán chè khá nổi tiếng tại Đà Nẵng, phục vụ nhiều loại chè truyền thống như chè đậu xanh, chè đậu đỏ, chè thập cẩm, chè bắp… Hương vị nhìn chung ngọt vừa, topping phong phú. Tuy nhiên, điểm trừ là đậu nấu còn cứng, chưa thật sự bùi mềm như mong đợi. Với những ai thích ăn đậu nhừ, cảm giác này có thể chưa hài lòng. Bù lại, nước cốt dừa béo thơm, tạo hương vị cân bằng cho ly chè.

💰 Giá cả

Giá chè ở mức bình dân, vừa túi tiền, dao động khoảng 15.000 – 25.000 VNĐ/ly. So với chất lượng thì khá ổn, phù hợp cho học sinh, sinh viên hoặc khách du lịch muốn thưởng thức món ngọt giải khát.

🏠 Không gian

Không gian quán gọn gàng, sạch sẽ, kiểu quán bình dân truyền thống. Bàn ghế nhựa đơn giản nhưng thoáng, dễ ngồi nhóm bạn nhỏ. Quán thường đông vào buổi tối nên đôi khi phải chờ một chút.

👩‍💼 Dịch vụ

Nhân viên phục vụ nhanh, lên món liền tay. Tuy không quá niềm nở nhưng vẫn giữ sự nhiệt tình, đáp ứng tốt nhu cầu của khách. Điểm cộng là khách có thể gọi nhiều loại topping kết hợp tùy thích.

⭐ Kết luận

Chè Xuân Trang là địa điểm thích hợp để thưởng thức các món chè Đà Nẵng với giá rẻ, không gian gần gũi. Nếu quán cải thiện việc nấu đậu mềm hơn, trải nghiệm sẽ trọn vẹn và hấp dẫn hơn rất nhiều.
textTranslated:
🍨 Food

Xuan Trang Dessert Shop is quite famous in Da Nang, serving many traditional desserts such as mung bean dessert, red bean dessert, mixed dessert, corn dessert… The taste is generally moderately sweet, with a wide variety of toppings. However, a drawback is that the beans are still a bit hard, not as soft and creamy as expected. For those who prefer soft beans, this might not be satisfying. On the other hand, the rich and fragrant coconut milk balances the flavor of the dessert.

💰 Price

The prices are affordable, ranging from 15,000 to 25,000 VND per cup. Compared to the quality, it's quite reasonable, suitable for students or tourists who want to enjoy a sweet and refreshing treat.

🏠 Atmosphere

The shop's space is neat, clean, and has a traditional, casual style. The simple plastic tables and chairs are spacious and comfortable for small groups. The shop is usually crowded in the evenings, so you might have to wait a little while.

👩‍💼 Service

The staff are quick and serve the food promptly. While not overly enthusiastic, they maintain a positive attitude and effectively meet customer needs. A plus is that customers can order many different toppings to combine as they like.

⭐ Conclusion

Xuan Trang Dessert Shop is a suitable place to enjoy Da Nang-style desserts at affordable prices in a cozy atmosphere. If the shop improves the cooking of the beans to make them softer, the experience will be much more complete and appealing.

text:
ダナンで有名なベトナムスイーツ「チェー」を食べに、チェースアントランに行ってきました。ここは地元でも昔から愛されている老舗だそうで、口コミでも多くの人に知られているようです。

店内はシンプルながらも清潔感があり、居心地が良かったです。席数も多く、広々としていました。メニューにはさまざまな種類のチェーやヨーグルトがあり、どれにしようか迷ってしまいましたが、評判の看板メニューである小豆チェーを注文しました。

運ばれてきたチェーは、噂通りに美味しくて驚きました。ほどよい甘さで、冷たくて濃厚なココナッツミルクと、柔らかく煮込まれた豆の相性が抜群です。私は小豆チェーにしましたが、他にもドリアンやジャックフルーツ、リュウガンなど、様々なフルーツが入ったミックスチェーも人気のようです。

値段もとても安く、この品質でこの価格は本当にありがたいです。一杯の量が少し少なめだという声もありましたが、私は逆に色々な種類を試したい人にはちょうど良い量だと感じました。

今回は平日の夜に行ったのですが、若者を中心に賑わっていました。遅い時間まで営業しているようで、夜20時半頃でもお客さんがたくさんいました。店員さんも親切で、テキパアウトで持ち帰るお客さんも多かったです。

お手頃な値段で美味しいチェーを楽しみたいなら、ここを強くおすすめします。
textTranslated:
I went to Che An Tran in Da Nang to try Che, a famous Vietnamese dessert. It's apparently a long-established shop loved by locals and well-known through word of mouth.

The interior was simple yet clean and comfortable. There were plenty of seats, and it felt spacious. The menu offered various types of Che and yogurt, making it difficult to choose, but I ordered the highly-rated signature dish, red bean Che.

The Che that arrived was surprisingly delicious, just as the rumors said. The sweetness was just right, and the combination of the cold, rich coconut milk and the tenderly cooked beans was excellent. While I chose red bean Che, mixed Che with various fruits like durian, jackfruit, and longan also seems to be popular.

The price was very reasonable; it's truly wonderful to get this quality at this price. Some people said the portion size was a little small, but I felt it was just the right amount for those who want to try several different kinds.

I went on a weekday evening, and it was bustling with young people. It seems they're open late, as there were still plenty of customers around 8:30 PM. The staff were friendly, and many customers were getting takeout.

If you want to enjoy delicious che at a reasonable price, I highly recommend this place.

textTranslated:
Specifically, the attitude of the staff member named Chính.

Before leaving, I told the staff I would return to the table, and they said okay. When I returned, the staff member cleared the table while the water was still on it. I asked the staff member who cleared it, and they said they didn't know and would clear it themselves, even though they did. I rate that staff member's attitude 1 star.

FOR FEEDBACK:

1. The staff member could have refused to hold the table.

2. The staff member's attitude was arrogant; they're just employees, not owners.

3. We've asked the staff to hold the table for us many times, but we've never come without ordering more food. Sometimes we even offered the staff a drink because we were too full.

If the customer had just left their jacket on the table and returned without saying anything, that would have been acceptable. But in this case, we had already instructed the staff.

But I come to support the shop every day, so why the attitude?
